architecture.mechanism: Prevention of abrasive and erosive wear caused by dust particle ingestion to avoid deterioration of fuel consumption.
architecture.intervention: Install a high-efficiency multi-stage air filtration system with inertial pre-separation specifically rated for sub-micron mineral dust to protect piston rings and cylinder walls from abrasive wear.
architecture.expected_effect: Restoration and maintenance of optimal cylinder compression and mechanical efficiency, thereby minimizing fuel consumption rates associated with component wear.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle in a controlled chamber with standardized ISO 12103-1 A2 coarse test dust for 500 hours and measure brake specific fuel consumption; if the increase exceeds 2% compared to a baseline clean-air run, the mechanism is insufficient.
